detail.name: Lucia's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Lucia's Mindscape: The Best Partner
detail.desc2:
A name card featuring the Night Emissary's image.
While exploring a Hollow on the edge of the city, the Investigative Association stumbled upon this card. It had been placed deep within an Ethereal nest, with a doodle of a witch brandishing her staff sketched on the back.
"At first we thought it was some kind of distress signal, but later realized it really was just a business card... Seriously, who in the world would hand something like that to an Ethereal?!"
